rules: Stage 10 backend_legacy_inventory.json is an immutable audit baseline; completed migrations are recorded here instead of rewriting history.
A removed source must have zero active hook, HTTP, Python-import and runtime consumers.
The canonical Door Cutting Order DocType base must remain because Frappe requires the active override to subclass it.
Public compatibility routes remain preserved until their route contract is explicitly retired.

migrations.name: Retired alternate Door Cutting Order controller chain
evidence: hooks.py activates only DoorCuttingOrderController, which subclasses the canonical DoorCuttingOrder DocType controller directly.
The active save path delegates to process_order_save and FrappeDoorCuttingOrderSaveGateway rather than the alternate controller chain.
Architecture contracts reject FastDoorCuttingOrder, TextBoardDoorCuttingOrder and DomainDoorCuttingOrder from the active controller.
The Stage 11 contract scans runtime Python sources and rejects imports or symbol references to the removed chain.
